subject: Request: bespoke accelerator mix + transient capacity guardrails for QuantaHealth
messages:
From: Elena Morales <elena@quantahealth.ai>
To: aditya.rao@redwood.com, laura.bennett@redwood.com
Cc: procurements@quantahealth.ai
Date: Tue, 27 Apr 2027 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: Dedicated capacity ask — mixed accelerators + transient burst cap

Hi Aditya / Laura,

Thanks again for the demo last week. We ran a short internal sizing exercise and have a non-standard request for our Dedicated reservation:

- Baseline reservation: 8x A100-80GB (steady-state) for inference and training prep.
- Transient burst: need ability to pop up to an additional 6x H100 for 4–6 hour windows during monthly model refreshes.
- We need a hard overage cap during those bursts — our procurement team requires an overage rate that caps at 1.5x baseline on a per-minute basis.
- We also need a 30-day reservation hold (no termination) while our legal finalizes the contract; we understand this is unusual but critical for our migration timeline.

Attached is a short spreadsheet with hourly traffic projections and the windows we expect to burst. We appreciate what you can do here; happy to jump on a call.

Best,
Elena Morales
Head of Infrastructure, QuantaHealth
elena@quantahealth.ai

--- Attachment: QuantaHealth_GPU_mix_and_traffic_profile.xlsx (xlsx, 42KB)
From: aditya.rao@redwood.com
To: laura.bennett@redwood.com, vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com
Cc: marissa.cole@redwood.com, rishi.malhotra@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 27 Apr 2027 15:34:00 -07:00
Subject: Fwd: Dedicated capacity ask — mixed accelerators + transient burst cap

Forwarding QuantaHealth's request — they want a mixed reservation (A100 baseline + transient H100 bursts), a 30-day reservation hold, and an overage cap at 1.5x baseline during burst windows. Spreadsheet attached.

Key constraints and asks:
- Technical: need to confirm H100 compatibility with their model (we can run validation but may need a short compatibility test window).
- Commercial: 30-day hold with reserved capacity charged up front, and a capped overage (1.5x).
- Operational: burst orchestration and preemption policies to avoid noisy-neighbor issues.

Laura / Vivek — can we approve this as a special-deal desk item? What limits do we want on burst hours, discounting for mixed SKUs, and whether we accept the 30-day hold without additional fee?

Thanks,
Aditya
Aditya Rao
Senior Account Executive, Redwood Inference
aditya.rao@redwood.com

--- Forwarded attachment: QuantaHealth_GPU_mix_and_traffic_profile.xlsx
From: vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com
To: aditya.rao@redwood.com, laura.bennett@redwood.com
Cc: marissa.cole@redwood.com, rishi.malhotra@redwood.com
Date: Wed, 28 Apr 2027 08:06:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Dedicated capacity ask — mixed accelerators + transient burst cap

Aditya — quick read. I’m supportive of a conditional approval with the following guardrails:

1) Burst eligibility: cap bursts to 6x H100 per month, with individual burst windows limited to 8 hours. If they exceed the monthly burst hours by >10%, auto-trigger a commercial review.
2) Overage pricing: approve a capped multiplier of 1.5x on per-minute tokenized billing during sanctioned burst windows. Outside sanctioned windows, standard on-demand pricing applies.
3) Reservation hold: allow a 30-day hold if QuantaHealth signs a non-binding intent and posts a 25% deposit of the reservation value; deposit refundable only if they withdraw prior to the contract signature less a 5% admin fee.
4) Technical validation: run a 2-hour H100 compatibility and performance test in our staging cluster; standard QA checklist must pass before we enable H100 bursts.
5) Discounting: up to 12% effective discount on baseline A100 reservation if they commit to 12 months; no additional discount on H100 transient usage.

Marissa / Rishi — operations and billing please confirm feasibility. If operations ok, authorize me to sign off and we can present a term-sheet.

Vivek Kulkarni
VP, Sales Operations
Redwood Inference
vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com

--- Note: this is an approval-in-principle. Final legal/finance must sign the term sheet.
From: aditya.rao@redwood.com
To: Elena Morales <elena@quantahealth.ai>, procurements@quantahealth.ai
Cc: laura.bennett@redwood.com, vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com, marissa.cole@redwood.com
Date: Wed, 28 Apr 2027 09:12:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Dedicated capacity ask — mixed accelerators + transient burst cap

Elena — thanks for the clear ask and the traffic spreadsheet. Good news: we have approval-in-principle from Sales Ops with concrete guardrails. Summary below — please review and confirm we can proceed to a term-sheet.

Summary of proposed terms (approval-in-principle):
- Baseline: 8x A100-80GB reserved (12-month commitment gives up to 12% discount on baseline).
- Transient bursts: up to 6x H100 for sanctioned windows (each window <= 8 hours). Monthly burst quota enforced; overages beyond quota trigger commercial review.
- Overage cap: 1.5x multiplier on per-minute billing during sanctioned burst windows only; outside those windows on-demand pricing applies.
- Reservation hold: 30-day hold accepted with a 25% deposit of reservation value payable on term-sheet signature; deposit refundable less 5% admin fee if canceled prior to full contract signature.
- Technical step: 2-hour H100 compatibility validation in Redwood staging; will schedule as soon as you confirm.

I’ve attached a draft term-sheet (QH-TS-v2-draft-term-sheet.pdf) with these items called out and the deposit/invoice language. If that aligns, I’ll route to Legal and Finance for final approval and DocuSign.

Next steps: please reply with confirmation of the burst windows in the attached spreadsheet and preferred dates for the H100 validation slot. Also confirm procurement point-of-contact for the deposit invoice.

Best,
Aditya
Senior Account Executive, Redwood Inference
--- Attachment: QH-TS-v2-draft-term-sheet.pdf (pdf, 74KB)
From: Elena Morales <elena@quantahealth.ai>
To: aditya.rao@redwood.com
Cc: procurements@quantahealth.ai
Date: Wed, 28 Apr 2027 09:44:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Dedicated capacity ask — mixed accelerators + transient burst cap

Aditya — that looks reasonable and much appreciated. We confirm the monthly burst windows in the spreadsheet (first five business days of each month, 4 hours each), and procurement will route the 25% deposit once we get the invoice. Please schedule the H100 validation any time next week (we prefer Tue/Wed morning PT).

Procurement contact: Jenna Park <jenna.park@quantahealth.ai>.

Elena
Head of Infrastructure, QuantaHealth
